summary_markdown: The conversation initially focused on accessing the `postgres` user on the sandbox database (`sandbox-db.allunite.local`). It was confirmed that the account is system-only, and access can be gained using `sudo -u postgres -s` followed by running `psql`. Later, a warning was issued regarding the stability of the sandbox environment, as it will be used for a large demonstration (for Finland) the next morning. While creating test data (10k facilities and 5 companies), participants were cautioned not to drop databases or overload the system due to its small size and potential performance issues.
decisions: Accessing the postgres user requires using `sudo -u postgres -s` followed by `psql`.
